params.body:
The workshop photos the client sent had no place on the site: a service in Sanity had no image field. With ShaneDeconinck/schoutteet-sanity's matching Studio change, an editor can give each service one photo.

## What changes

- `Services::all()` carries a service's `image` from Sanity (only when it has an asset).
- On /diensten the photo shows wide under the service's lead, 16:9, cropped to the editor's hotspot, with `srcset` 800/1200/1600 and lazy loading. Its alt text comes from the image, otherwise the service title.
- A service without a photo, and every built-in service, renders exactly as before.

## Checked

- `php artisan test`: 56 passed; the Sanity services test now also asserts the CDN URL and the alt text.
- `vendor/bin/pint --test`: clean.
- Rendered locally with one of the uploaded workshop photos, at 1280 px and 390 px wide.
params.title: Services: an optional photo per service, under the lead
